name: Ezz Steel
source: FY2021 column added from EZZ STEEL REPORTS CONSOLIDATED FY 2021 RESULTS (audited, Egyptian Accounting Standards), published 2 March 2022: key highlights Net sales 67,819 EGP mn, Gross profit 13,770, Net profit before tax 7,172, Net profit 5,398, EPS 6.61 EGP; page 5 cost of goods sold table gives consolidated COGS 54,048 EGP mn. Income Tax is the sum of the deferred tax 844 mn and income tax 930 mn the release states, and profit before tax less that 1,774 mn reproduces the printed 5,398 mn exactly. Amounts stored x1,000,000 in EGP. Sales less COGS is 13,771 against the printed gross profit of 13,770, a one million EGP rounding difference in the release itself, so both printed figures are stored as published. Operating expenses, operating profit and net finance costs are left empty because the release publishes no selling, general and administrative breakdown and no depreciation figure, and the FY2021 audited statements PDF is a scanned image with no text layer. | Ezz Steel Company (SAE) Consolidated Financial Statements for the year ended 31 December 2023, audited, consolidated statement of income, printed in EGP thousands and stored here in absolute EGP
note: Consolidated statement of income, absolute EGP (the audited statement prints EGP thousands). Operating Expenses is selling and marketing plus general and administrative plus other operating expenses. Operating Profit (EBIT) is derived as gross profit plus other operating revenues less operating expenses, which reproduces the printed operating profit of 33640236000 (FY2023) and 15346995000 (FY2022). Income Tax is stored as printed net of deferred tax and is negative in FY2023 because it is a net credit: current tax expense 3745659000 less deferred tax asset 4012487000. The issuer's investor relations page publishes consolidated financial statements up to Q2 2024 only, so FY2024 and FY2025 are not available from the issuer.

rows.label: Operating Profit (EBIT)
rows.derivedFormula: Operating Profit (EBIT) = Gross Profit - Operating Expenses
